dimensions.assessment: Affects administrative operations of the Department of the Interior and U.S. Customs and Border Protection on specific federal land parcels.
dimensions.evidence: Administrative jurisdiction over approximately 25 acres of Federal land in Harpers Ferry, West Virginia... is transferred from the Secretary of the Interior... to the Commissioner of U.S. Customs and Border Protection

dimensions.assessment: Shifts management responsibilities for specific federal land parcels without monetary reimbursement.
dimensions.evidence: A transfer of administrative jurisdiction over Federal land under paragraph (1)(A) or (2) shall be without monetary reimbursement or additional consideration.

dimensions.assessment: Requires survey costs to be charged to existing CBP appropriations without new spending authorizations.
dimensions.evidence: The cost of the survey under paragraph (1)(A) shall be charged to an appropriation of the U.S. Customs and Border Protection.

dimensions.assessment: Applies strictly to boundary adjustments and jurisdiction transfers for specific acreage in one location.
dimensions.evidence: The Federal land transferred by subparagraph (A) is excluded from the boundary of Harpers Ferry National Historical Park.

dimensions.assessment: Provides permanent administrative transfers with provisions for potential future reversion back to the Department of the Interior.
dimensions.evidence: the Commissioner of U.S. Customs and Border Protection shall transfer administrative jurisdiction over the Federal land... to the Secretary

importance_detail.rationale: Transfers administrative jurisdiction of specific federal land parcels between the Department of the Interior and U.S. Customs and Border Protection in Harpers Ferry, West Virginia.
